Yes, **ActivStyle** is a legitimate home medical supply company that provides home delivery of incontinence and bladder control products, primarily for individuals covered by Medicaid or specific health plans. [](https://www.facebook.com/ActivStyle/videos/activstyle-tv-commercial-30-seconds/430143417816598/)

Headquartered in Minnesota, the company is accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Health Care (ACHC) and works directly with state Medicaid programs, managed care organizations, doctors, and patients to coordinate insurance-covered shipments. [](https://www.activstyle.com/)

- **Insurance Verification:** They check your specific health plan or Medicaid eligibility to see if supplies are covered at little to no out-of-pocket cost.

- **Consultation & Samples:**

A personal consultant helps determine the right products and can send initial samples.

- **Paperwork Management:** ActivStyle coordinates with your doctor's office to gather the required medical necessity paperwork.

- **Home Delivery:** Products are shipped directly and discreetly to your door, often on a recurring monthly schedule. [](https://www.activstyle.com/customer-reviews/)

### What to Keep in Mind

- **Insurance Restrictions:** Coverage depends heavily on your specific state Medicaid program or insurance plan. Some users on forums note that they do not accept every type of plan or specialized Medicare/Medicaid dual-eligibility tier, so you must verify coverage with them directly. [](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/activeinstyle.com)

- **Communication:** Like many medical supply companies, they will regularly call or email to re-verify insurance information and coordinate refills, which some customers find persistent.
